attack_techniques: Trusted Developer Utilities Proxy Execution: MSBuild (T1127.001)
attackers_goals: Gain code execution on the host and evade security controls.
description: A suspicious process in the Microsoft .NET directory loaded the Microsoft Build Framework DLL. This may occur if an attacker masquerades a process like MSBuild (PowerLessShell).
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Suspicious .NET process loads an MSBuild DLL
